what:
BEFORE spinning off a planning session, ALWAYS check if a plan document already exists for that topic (correction 2026-04-20).

Check order:
1. `docs/specs/<TOPIC>*.md` in the primary worktree via `ls /Users/meky/code/aide-v0/docs/specs/`
2. `git log --all --oneline -- 'docs/specs/<TOPIC>*.md'` for committed versions on any branch
3. Recent spawn worktree outputs under `.claude/worktrees/*/docs/specs/`
4. If a plan exists → reconcile against it, don't spawn duplicate planning work. Spawn implementation sessions instead.

Context that triggered this rule: user already had `docs/specs/BINARY_MIGRATION_PLAN.md` (572 lines, uncommitted in primary worktree) when Claude spun off a new binary planning session, resulting in duplicate work. User called this out directly.
why: User correction: avoid duplicate planning work. Always survey existing plans first. Especially important when user has been working in primary worktree without committing — files can exist on disk but not in git history yet.
